description: City-based duplicate IP reporting for 7-day and 30-day operating windows. Uses duplicate IP snapshots captured by the application and city filters from the indexed proxies table for faster dashboard loading.

panels.description: Distinct duplicated outbound IPs observed in the selected time range for the selected proxy cities. Reads from precomputed duplicate-IP snapshots.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT city AS city_name
  FROM proxies
  WHERE '${city:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    AND city IS NOT NULL
    AND city != ''
  UNION
  SELECT city_name
  FROM JSON_TABLE(
    CAST('${city:json}' AS JSON),
    '$[*]' COLUMNS (city_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')
  ) AS selected_city
  WHERE '${city:raw}' NOT IN ('$__all', '')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.last_ip) AS value
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows x
WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
  AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
  AND x.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM selected_cities sc
    WHERE LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', sc.city_name, ','), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
      OR LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', sc.city_name, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
  )

panels.title: Duplicated IPs Detected

panels.description: Peak affected phones in a single scan for selected cities. Uses the precomputed phones_on_same_ip snapshot count to avoid expanding phone lists on every dashboard load.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT city AS city_name
  FROM proxies
  WHERE '${city:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    AND city IS NOT NULL
    AND city != ''
  UNION
  SELECT city_name
  FROM JSON_TABLE(
    CAST('${city:json}' AS JSON),
    '$[*]' COLUMNS (city_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')
  ) AS selected_city
  WHERE '${city:raw}' NOT IN ('$__all', '')
), scan_counts AS (
  SELECT
    x.captured_at,
    SUM(x.phones_on_same_ip) AS affected_phones
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows x
  WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
    AND x.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM selected_cities sc
      WHERE LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', sc.city_name, ','), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
        OR LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', sc.city_name, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
    )
  GROUP BY x.captured_at
)
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(affected_phones), 0) AS value
FROM scan_counts

panels.title: Peak Phones Affected

panels.description: Percentage of duplicate IP scan rows where all phones sharing the IP were on one server label.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT city AS city_name
  FROM proxies
  WHERE '${city:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    AND city IS NOT NULL
    AND city != ''
  UNION
  SELECT city_name
  FROM JSON_TABLE(
    CAST('${city:json}' AS JSON),
    '$[*]' COLUMNS (city_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')
  ) AS selected_city
  WHERE '${city:raw}' NOT IN ('$__all', '')
), filtered_rows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT x.captured_at, x.last_ip
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows x
  WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
    AND x.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM selected_cities sc
      WHERE LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', sc.city_name, ','), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
        OR LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', sc.city_name, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
    )
), row_scope AS (
  SELECT
    fr.captured_at,
    fr.last_ip,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) AS server_count
  FROM filtered_rows fr
  JOIN duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
    ON s.captured_at = fr.captured_at
    AND s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND s.last_ip = fr.last_ip
  GROUP BY fr.captured_at, fr.last_ip
)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN server_count = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2), 0) AS value
FROM row_scope

panels.title: % Across Servers

panels.description: Average daily affected-phone rate across the selected time range. Each 24h group uses duplicate-IP snapshots for the numerator and active proxy count by city for the denominator.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT city AS city_name
  FROM proxies
  WHERE '${city:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    AND city IS NOT NULL
    AND city != ''
  UNION
  SELECT city_name
  FROM JSON_TABLE(
    CAST('${city:json}' AS JSON),
    '$[*]' COLUMNS (city_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')
  ) AS selected_city
  WHERE '${city:raw}' NOT IN ('$__all', '')
), active_proxy_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_phones
  FROM proxies
  WHERE active = true
    AND city IN ($city)
), daily_affected AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(x.captured_at) AS scan_day,
    SUM(x.phones_on_same_ip) AS affected_phones
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows x
  WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
    AND x.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM selected_cities sc
      WHERE LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', sc.city_name, ','), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
        OR LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', sc.city_name, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
    )
  GROUP BY DATE(x.captured_at)
)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(daily_affected.affected_phones * 100.0 / NULLIF(active_proxy_count.total_phones, 0)), 2), 0) AS value
FROM daily_affected
CROSS JOIN active_proxy_count

Duplicate Details by City, Server, and Phone

panels.description: Duplicate-IP evidence for the selected cities and time range. Uses the snapshot row's precomputed phone list and server list instead of expanding every phone on dashboard load.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT city AS city_name
  FROM proxies
  WHERE '${city:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    AND city IS NOT NULL
    AND city != ''
  UNION
  SELECT city_name
  FROM JSON_TABLE(
    CAST('${city:json}' AS JSON),
    '$[*]' COLUMNS (city_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')
  ) AS selected_city
  WHERE '${city:raw}' NOT IN ('$__all', '')
), filtered_rows AS (
  SELECT
    x.captured_at,
    x.last_ip,
    x.location,
    x.phones_on_same_ip,
    x.all_servers_on_ip,
    x.sibling_phones,
    x.device_ids
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows x
  WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
    AND x.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM selected_cities sc
      WHERE LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', sc.city_name, ','), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
        OR LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', sc.city_name, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
    )
), ip_scope AS (
  SELECT
    fr.captured_at,
    fr.last_ip,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) AS server_count
  FROM filtered_rows fr
  JOIN duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
    ON s.captured_at = fr.captured_at
    AND s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND s.last_ip = fr.last_ip
  GROUP BY fr.captured_at, fr.last_ip
)
SELECT
  fr.location,
  fr.last_ip,
  MAX(fr.all_servers_on_ip) AS all_servers_on_ip,
  CASE WHEN MAX(ip_scope.server_count) > 1 THEN 'across_servers' ELSE 'within_server' END AS dup_scope,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fr.captured_at) AS scan_appearances,
  MIN(fr.captured_at) AS first_seen,
  MAX(fr.captured_at) AS last_seen,
  MAX(fr.phones_on_same_ip) AS max_phones_on_ip,
  MAX(fr.sibling_phones) AS duplicated_phones,
  MAX(fr.device_ids) AS duplicated_device_ids
FROM filtered_rows fr
JOIN ip_scope
  ON ip_scope.captured_at = fr.captured_at
  AND ip_scope.last_ip = fr.last_ip
GROUP BY fr.location, fr.last_ip
ORDER BY scan_appearances DESC, max_phones_on_ip DESC, fr.location, fr.last_ip
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Duplicated IP and Phone Details

panels.description: One point per day per selected city. The value is the number of distinct duplicated IPs observed that day, read from duplicate-IP snapshots without expanding device_ids.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT city AS city_name
  FROM proxies
  WHERE '${city:raw}' IN ('$__all', '')
    AND city IS NOT NULL
    AND city != ''
  UNION
  SELECT city_name
  FROM JSON_TABLE(
    CAST('${city:json}' AS JSON),
    '$[*]' COLUMNS (city_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')
  ) AS selected_city
  WHERE '${city:raw}' NOT IN ('$__all', '')
)
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(x.captured_at)) AS time_sec,
  sc.city_name AS metric,
  COUNT(DISTINCT x.last_ip) AS value
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows x
JOIN selected_cities sc
  ON LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', sc.city_name, ','), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
  OR LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', sc.city_name, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.location, ''), ' | ')) > 0
WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
  AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
  AND x.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
GROUP BY DATE(x.captured_at), sc.city_name
ORDER BY time_sec, metric
